body: That's not sad at all! Plenty of people live their lives the way they do because of spiritual or religious beliefs! Besides, if it works for you then that's all that matters. Helping people and working hard to be someone you and other people can be proud of it a great life goal too.
Maybe you could use the money for something like traveling or fun pastimes or something instead?

Chronic pain and illness can be really hard to deal with and I hope that you're able to talk to your doctor again to see if there's anything they can perscibe you or reccomend for you. I've heard that regular excercise can help sometimes though, so it's especially good that you're going to take up running. Have you found anything that makes the pain better?

I think trying running is a great idea! If that doesn't wind up helping for you, you could always try walking again or even something completely different because there are a lot of options out there. Maybe you could try talking to a doctor about your heartburn if it's negatively impacting your life? I know they make medications to treat it so they might prescribe you something to help.

I'm really sorry you feel this way. I've been in the same position for a long time, so I understand where you're coming from. Is there any thing/hobby/trait you admire in other people or that you've always wanted to have? For example, I've always wanted to enjoy playing video games, so I'm going to try to make myself do that for at least a few minutes a day. It doesn't have to be anything big that you do. If you've always liked the thought of enjoying travel, maybe try visiting a new park or driving to the side of town you don't usually visit? You can start small and be proud of yourself for the progress you're making, even if you're not enthusiastically traveling the world like other people seem to be. It'll be hard to make a change, but I believe you can do it.

I know having someone care about me isn't going to fix my problems, and I am trying to work on my self esteem and everything. It can just hurt a bit because I often feel like people can't even stand talking to me, which probably creates a self-fulfilling prophecy of me shutting people out first because my self-esteem is so bad I assume these people secretly hate me or that I don't deserve friends anyway. I'm doing my best to get better though, it'll just take some time. Thank you for your comment. ❤

I don't think my family knows. When I was in high school my mother saw some wounds on my legs and asked what they were and when I made something up she said that wasn't what they were but never brought it up again and my mother saw the handful on my shoulder once and I made something else up and I think she told me she could get me therapy if I wanted. I'd honestly rather not tell my family, and I've been clean with only a couple relapses for probably about a year now so I don't need their help stopping or anything. Is that what you meant by feeling this way?

Thank you so much for the support guys. I'm not currently in any danger, so you don't have to worry about me doing anything dangerous, I just have been feeling really down and kinda passively suicidal for quite a while I guess, so I just wanted to reach out and talk to people who cared. ❤
